high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a webpage from marktechpost.com, displaying an article about the development of a new multilingual encoder called mmBERT. The page is titled "Why was a new multilingual encoder needed?" and discusses the dominance of XLM-RoBERTa (XLM-R) in multilingual NLP for over five years. It mentions that while encoder-only models like BERT and RoBERTa were central to early progress, most research energy shifted toward decoder-based generative models. However, encoders remain more efficient and often outperform decoders on embedding, retrieval, and classification tasks.
